stock.description: Boltek Holdings Limited, founded in 2005 and based in Tsim Sha Tsui, Hong Kong, operates as an investment holding company. Its core business centers on delivering specialized engineering consultancy services, primarily for infrastructure development projects across Hong Kong. The firm's comprehensive engineering expertise spans civil engineering, encompassing road and structural design, as well as geotechnical analysis, traffic management, and building engineering. Boltek applies these services to a wide array of infrastructure works, including the construction and improvement of roads, bridges, noise abatement structures, accessible facilities, slope stabilization, foundation works, drainage systems, and river walls. Additionally, the company offers supplementary services such as deploying engineering and related staff to government agencies on a contractual basis, and providing advisory services concerning the implementation of contract administration procedures within infrastructure development initiatives.
